About Radiant Vista – Business Hotel in Hubballi

Radiant Vista is a business hotel on Gokul Road in Hubballi, Karnataka, close to Hubballi Airport, with three room types, the Brick and Brew restaurant, the Breeze Point rooftop bar and the Gala Vista banquet halls.

The hotel is designed for corporate travellers, families and anyone in the city for a celebration. It brings the efficiency of a business hotel together with the warmth of a place to relax.

You will find designer rooms, two places to eat and drink, the Brick and Brew restaurant and the Breeze Point rooftop bar, and the Gala Vista halls for banquets and conferences. The front desk is open around the clock.

Dining – Brick and Brew Restaurant in Hubballi

1 / 4
"It’s India but cooler, sassier, and way more Instagrammable."

Brick and Brew

"Premium Nostalgia"

Brick and Brew is the hotel's in-house restaurant. It serves nostalgic Indian favourites with a bold, modern edge, for hotel guests and local food lovers alike.

Walk in and you’re hit with retro Bollywood beats, earthy vibes, and comforting food favourites served with a bold, modern twist. Born from a love for nostalgic flavours, Brick and Brew blends the cherished tastes of the past with the style and spirit of today’s India.

Think butter chicken that looks like a masterpiece, momos with a gourmet dimsum twist, and nani’s dal served with five-star plating elegance.

It is an easy choice for a family meal, a business lunch or dinner with colleagues, a short drive from Inorbit Mall.

Rooftop Restaurant & Bar

Unwind with stunning views and a cozy ambiance at our Rooftop Bar and Restaurant. From our barman creating classic curated cocktails to savoury bites, each dish is thoughtfully crafted to elevate your experience.

Explore Hubballi

Nearby Places & Attractions in Hubballi

The hotel's location on Gokul Road puts shopping, transport and the city's best-known sights within easy reach:

  • Inorbit Mall Hubballi

    The city's main mall for shopping, dining and family entertainment, a short drive from the hotel.

  • Hubballi Airport

    The domestic airport sits on the same Gokul Road corridor as the hotel, which makes airport transfers easy.

  • Hubballi Junction

    The main railway station of the South Western Railway zone, with trains to Bengaluru, Mumbai, Goa and beyond.

  • Unkal Lake

    A 110-year-old lake with parkland, boating and a large statue of Swami Vivekananda. Popular at sunset.

  • Chandramouleshwara Temple

    An 11th-century Western Chalukya temple known for its detailed black stone carvings.

  • Nrupatunga Betta

    A hilltop viewpoint with wide views over Hubballi-Dharwad, best visited at sunrise or sunset.

  • Siddharoodha Math

    A historic spiritual centre and ashram dedicated to Sri Siddharoodha Swami, visited by devotees from across the region.

  • Indira Gandhi Glass House Garden

    A public garden with a glass house modelled on London's Crystal Palace. It hosts the city's flower shows.

For opening times, tips and more places to visit, see our Hubballi guide.

Getting Here

Location & Accessibility – Gokul Road, Hubballi

Radiant Vista, Plot No 04, S/No 106A, 107B, 108A & 109A, Gokul Road, Akshay Park, Hubballi, Karnataka 580030, India
Phone: +91 836 200 2487
Email: reservations@hotelradiantvista.com

The hotel is in Akshay Park on Gokul Road, the main road to Hubballi Airport. Here is how to reach us:

  1. From Hubballi Airport. Leave the airport on Gokul Road. Radiant Vista is on the same road in Akshay Park, so there is no need to cross the city centre.
  2. From Hubballi Junction railway station. Take a taxi or auto-rickshaw towards Gokul Road and ask for Akshay Park. Share your train time with reservations if you would like help with transport.
  3. From the Hubballi new bus stand. Take a taxi or auto-rickshaw along Gokul Road to Akshay Park; the hotel is on the main road.

Frequently Asked Questions

Frequently Asked Questions About Radiant Vista Hubballi

Where is Radiant Vista located?

Radiant Vista is at Plot No 04, S/No 106A, 107B, 108A & 109A, Gokul Road, Akshay Park, Hubballi, Karnataka 580030. The hotel is on Gokul Road, the same corridor as Hubballi Airport, and close to Inorbit Mall. Hubballi Junction railway station and the city centre are an easy drive away.

Is Hubballi the same city as Hubli?

Yes. Hubballi is the official Kannada name and Hubli is the older English spelling of the same city in northern Karnataka. Together with Dharwad it forms the twin city of Hubballi-Dharwad, the second-largest urban area in the state after Bengaluru.

Does Radiant Vista have a restaurant?

Yes. Brick and Brew is the hotel's restaurant. It serves nostalgic Indian favourites with a modern twist, such as butter chicken, momos with a dim sum touch and home-style dal, in a lively setting with retro Bollywood music. Hotel guests and visitors are both welcome.

Is there a rooftop bar at Radiant Vista?

Yes. Breeze Point is the hotel's open-roof rooftop bar and restaurant. It serves curated cocktails and savoury dishes with views over Hubballi. Separate areas make it suitable for a quiet dinner for two or a night out with friends. Enquire on WhatsApp to reserve a table.

Can I book a banquet hall for a wedding or a corporate event?

Yes. Gala Vista has two halls. Gala Vista I is a grand banquet hall for weddings and receptions. Gala Vista II is a conference and event space for seminars and meetings. Call +91 836 200 2487 or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com to check dates and packages.

What room types does Radiant Vista offer?

There are three room types: the Classic Room, the Premium Room and the Suite. Every room has individually controlled air conditioning, a 42-inch Smart TV and high-speed Wi-Fi. Premium Rooms and Suites add a mini fridge and a safe deposit locker, and the Suite has a separate lounge.

Is Radiant Vista a good choice for business travellers?

Yes. It is a business hotel close to the airport, with a business center, work desks in every room, high-speed Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk. Gala Vista II hosts meetings and training sessions, and the travel desk can help with local transport.

How do I book a room or reserve a table?

Book a room online through our booking engine, or call reservations on +91 91871 95517. You can also WhatsApp the same number, call the front desk on +91 836 200 2487 or email reservations@hotelradiantvista.com. For Brick and Brew or Breeze Point, a WhatsApp message is the quickest way to reserve.
